blocks.html: And by the same means answer is made to this, that during the said three years the said de Rols made no complaint of it, but rather obstinately maintained, against those who said the contrary, that this same du Tilh was Martin Guerre her husband; nay, when he was under prosecution [en prevention: a judge having taken cognizance of a matter against him] for the same deed before the Seneschal of Toulouse, she went often to see him, giving him succour of money and of other necessary things — remaining, as is to be presumed, always in this error.
